questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in Nigeria
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 11.4% in 2020, from 34.1% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in the United States
questions.hint: Think about the effect of heart-disease treatment, and then of opioids and COVID-19.
questions.explanation: It rose to 77.0 years in 2020, from 68.1 years in 1950. US life expectancy fell during the COVID-19 pandemic.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in India
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It fell to 0.9% in 2020, from 2.1% in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Deaths in fires in England
questions.hint: Most fire deaths happen at home; think about smoke alarms, fewer smokers and safer furniture.
questions.explanation: It fell to 260 in 2025, from 765 in 1985. Financial years from April, each shown at the year it starts: 2020 is April 2020 to March 2021. Counts deaths fire and rescue services recorded as fire-related, including those where the role of fire was not known.

source.attribution: UK Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

questions.title: Births per 1,000 teenage girls in the United Kingdom
questions.hint: Think about when girls marry, how long they stay in school, and access to contraception.
questions.explanation: It went from 22 in 1950 to a high of 49 in 1970, then ended at 10 in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
